items.headline: Council to discuss city property deal on Finch Avenue
items.summary: The October 6 closed-session agenda lists real property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue in Cupertino, with the City Manager and Interim City Attorney acting as the city's negotiators.

items.headline: Garage conversions to ADUs show up repeatedly in permits
items.summary: Several permits this week convert existing garages into accessory dwelling units, including at 1226 Locust Street #2, 1543 Burrell Court #2, and 2523 Sleepy Hollow Lane #2, plus a legalization of an existing garage conversion into a JADU at 3365 Casalegno Court — a cheaper path to adding housing than new detached construction.

items.headline: Priciest ADU permit this week valued near $176,000
items.summary: A detached accessory dwelling unit at 1413 Gordy Drive #2 received a permit with a declared permit valuation of $175,920, the highest among the ADU permits in this batch.

items.headline: Palo Alto to replace temporary SB 9 housing ordinances
items.summary: The September 30 agenda listed a recommendation on an ordinance amending Palo Alto's building, zoning, and subdivision codes to replace temporary rules that implemented state housing laws SB 9 and SB 450 with permanent ones. These are the state laws that allow lot splits and duplexes in single-family zones.

items.headline: Chabad seeks permit for community center on Fremont Ave
items.summary: A use permit application before the Zoning Administrator would allow Chabad of Sunnyvale to operate a religious assembly/community space inside an existing commercial building at 645 W. Fremont Avenue.

items.headline: 408 homes proposed on El Camino Real
items.summary: The council's September 22 agenda included a public hearing on annexing and rezoning 451-475 El Camino Real for 408 residential units, with an Environmental Impact Report prepared under state environmental law and a vesting tentative subdivision map also up for action.
